programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Penguins: The African Chaplin
programme.desc: The African penguin is the only penguin species in Africa. Their clumsy demeanour has seen them called the Charlie Chaplins of the bird world. But they are struggling to escape extinction. Despite the protection of their breeding islands, numbers fall. Scientists race to find the answers for the staggering decline. Is there a glimmer of hope for the African Chaplin?

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales
programme.desc: North Atlantic right whales are dying faster than they can reproduce. With less than 400 remaining, these great whales rarely die of natural causes. Instead they are run over by ships or suffer lethal injuries from fishing gear. If we don't stop killing them, in 20 years they could be extinct. From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and hugs her. Seeing this, Sulakshana is left flabbergasted. She tells Indravadhan that he cannot do this. Sulakshana insults Gayatri which infuriates Indravadhan, who starts scolding Sulakshana. The argument draws Raj Mata and Badi Raani Maa to the scene. Indravadhan tells them that Sulakshana has changed and what she now wants is the title of the queen, whereas Gayatri wants love. Indravadhan declares that the next morning, he and Gayatri would leave the Raj Mahal. What will Sulakshana's reaction be hearing this statement? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: As planned by Sulakshana and Badi Raani Maa, a bomb is planted in Indravadhan's car and they wait for it to explode. To Badi Raani Maa and Sulakshan's surprise, Indravadhan and Gayatri escape alive. Seeing they are unharmed, Badi Raani Maa tells them that she heared the news of the bomb exploding. Later, Gayatri questions Badi Raani Maa about how she knew about the explosion. What answer will Badi Raani Maa's have for Gayatri? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri follows the woman wearing the black saree and realizes that she is none other than Badi Raani Maa. Gayatri is flabbergasted to realize the truth. Just as she learns the truth, she leaves the place but she is caught by Badi Raani Maa. Badi Raani Maa stops Gayatri and tells her the actual story and claims that she is not Indravadhan's grandmother. Will Gayatri reveal this truth to Indravadhan? Will he believe this? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Badi Raani Maa where Raani Maa shows her the wounds which confirm that whatever Gayatri saw was real. Badi Raani tells Gayatri that she wants to separate her and Indravadhan and that is the reason she is plotting all this. She even adds on that she has mixed poison in the 'Laddoos' which would be served to Indravadhan. Later, when Indravadhan is about to eat the 'Laddoos', Gayatri shows up in the scene and claims that the 'Laddoos' have been poisoned. What will Indravadhan's reaction be upon hearing this? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri takes Indravadhan to Badi Raani Maa's store room and shows him the skeleton of Sulakshana. Indravadhan is flabbergasted to hear that and uncovers the skeleton that was covered with a piece of cloth. At the same time, Badi Raani Maa reaches the scene and she has her hands tied up. Indravadhan unties Badi Raani Maa's hands as she reveals that Gayatri had tied her up. Gayatri is shocked to hear what Badi Raani Maa had just said and Indravadhan is also shocked hearing this. Badi Raani Maa also says that Gayatri wants to kill her and she is jealous of Sulakshana. Will Indravadhan believe in Badi Raani Maa's words? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.3
programme.desc: Tormented by the shattered fragments of the sacred jar of King Taejo, Gwanghae seeks out Son Haengsu. Recognizing him, Hwa-ryeong urges Gwanghae to meet Jeongi, and he is stunned to learn that she is Euldam's daughter. When Jeongi falls from her horse and lands in Gwanghae's arms, she panics and struggles in surprise—only for them both to tumble to the ground.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.4
programme.desc: Determined to prove that the sacred jar of King Taejo was deliberately broken, Gangcheon drops the vessel onto the floor. As King Seonjo erupts in fury, Gwanghae steps forward and claims full responsibility for the act. King Seonjo immediately orders Euldam's arrest. In a desperate attempt to save her father, Jeongi strikes the petition drum, proclaiming Euldam's innocence to the court…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.5
programme.desc: Jeongi clings to Euldam, sobbing and begging him not to go, while the wounded Taedo fumes in frustration after seeing an assassin vanish into the darkness. Seeking out Hwa-ryeong, Jeongi travels to the merchant guild, where she comes face to face with Gangcheon. She boldly asks whether he will apologize for humiliating Euldam once she becomes the greatest master potter in Joseon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.6
programme.desc: Jeongi accuses Gwanghae of stealing her jade belt, and as she tries to flee and leave him behind, she is seized once again by Gwanghae. Forced to wander with their wrists bound together, the two soon find themselves in grave danger. As punishment for losing the royal jade belt, Gwanghae is assigned as deputy director under the chief artisan Shinseong. Meanwhile, Jeongi sets out on a journey to enter the Bunwon pottery workshop…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.7
programme.desc: Reunited at last, Jeongi and Taedo recognize each other and share all that has happened. Taedo reluctantly lets Jeongi go as she sets her sights on the Bunwon workshop. Entering the Gongchogun selection exam, Jeongi is arrested and thrown into jail after being accused of attempting to cut down palace trees while searching for firewood. Desperate, she pleads with Gwanghae for help, insisting that she must become a master potter no matter what.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.8
programme.desc: Mistaking it for Gwanghae's test, Jeongi sneaks into the Bunwon storeroom to choose pottery, only to be caught red-handed by Gangcheon. While confined, she finally realizes that the man she believed to be Gwanghae was actually someone else. As Jeongi tearfully confesses all the wrongs she has committed against him, Gwanghae listens with a quiet smile.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES

The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

Si rendono conto ben presto che il lavoro è qualcosa di più di una semplice ricerca di amianto o mercurio. L'enorme edificio nasconde segreti molto più oscuri.

Questa sarà presto sostituita da una pista coperta gestita dal dinamico imprenditore Noah. Mentre Courtney combatte per salvare la pista, finirà per innamorarsi del suo bel rivale.

programme.title: CHRISTMAS DANCE

programme.title: La sfilata di Natale

programme.title: Una babysitter per Natale

programme.title: 12 regali di Natale

programme.title: Finchè giudice non ci separi

Massimo è il più fresco di separazione e il giudice gli ha levato tutto: la casa, la figlia e lo ha costretto a versare un cospicuo assegno mensile alla moglie. I tre amici gli stanno vicino per rincuorarlo e dargli consigli per affrontare la separazione e tornare a vivere una vita normale, ma le sorprese sono dietro l'angolo.

programme.title: Un uomo perbene

Inizia così un calvario giudiziario e umano che porta Tortora da una prigione all'altra nel tentativo di provare la sua innocenza. Con Michele Placido, Stefano Accorsi e Giovanna Mezzogiorno.

programme.title: Le amiche del cuore
programme.desc: Presentato al 45º Festival di Cannes, il film segna l'esordio della diciottenne Claudia Pandolfi. Tre amiche adolescenti vivono nella periferia romana. Claudia vuole fare la fotomodella, Morena studia da infermiera e accudisce la madre malata, Simona è una ragazza chiusa, che non va a scuola, e dentro di sé nasconde un segreto profondo…

programme.title: Ciurè
programme.desc: In una Palermo dal sapore autentico, tra il cemento e la ruggine della periferia e le paillettes colorate di un night club, un uomo è costretto a trovare ogni modo per campare suo figlio finché non incontra una ballerina transgender. Possono due mondi, cosi lontani e diversi fra loro aiutarsi a vicenda a risolvere i loro problemi?

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami

programme.title: Riusciranno i nostri eroi a ritrovare l'amico misteriosamente scomparso in Africa?
programme.desc: Divertentissima commedia con il grande Alberto Sordi. Un editore romano, portandosi dietro il suo fido ragioniere, parte per l'Africa alla ricerca di un suo amico misteriosamente scomparso da più di due anni. Dopo varie peripezie i due scoprono che l'amico ha lasciato dietro di sé la civiltà e si è insediato in una tribù d'indigeni dove si è spacciato per un'altra persona.

programme.title: La mandragola
programme.desc: Nella Firenze del Cinquecento, Callimaco escogita una beffa elaborata per conquistare la bella Lucrezia, moglie del credulone Nicia. Con l'aiuto di Ligurio e di un frate compiacente, si finge medico e mette in moto un inganno sempre più audace.

programme.title: La donna del giorno
programme.desc: Una giovane donna cerca di farsi strada nel mondo del lavoro e della vita sociale, ma si trova coinvolta in una relazione complicata con un uomo di potere che la sfrutta e la manipola per i propri fini.

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani

Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Animali selvatici

Alex ha un piano: rapinare una banca in un paesino di campagna. Tamara insiste per andare con lui e il ragazzo acconsente con riluttanza. Tutto va esattamente come previsto finché si avvicina Robert, un poliziotto felicemente sposato che vive in una fattoria vicino.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

Lincoln Jefferson è un veterano del corpo dei Marines e lavora come custode in un prestigioso liceo della California: un lavoro che si è trovato per garantire l'iscrizione alla scuola del figlio quattordicenne, KJ.

Dopo aver messo a segno un colpo grosso, il General Manager Sonny Weaver Jr. ha il controllo della favorita. Sonny affronta la decisione più grande della sua vita.

Un uomo che sta scrivendo un libro sul paranormale, si reca a New York e soggiorna in una stanza d'albergo che si dice sia responsabile della morte di tutti gli ospiti che vi soggiornano.

A seguito della morte di quest'ultima, i suoi aguzzini vengono arrestati con l'accusa di omicidio. Nella capitale giunge Nicole, giornalista newyorchese, che vuole indagare sul caso.

programme.desc: Un imprevisto matrimonio della vigilia costringe una donna a trascorrere il Natale nella campagna inglese, dove la collaborazione con un uomo del posto si trasforma in qualcosa di più.

programme.title: Come in un film di Natale
programme.desc: Due sorelle si risvegliano misteriosamente all'interno di un perfetto film natalizio e devono capire come vivere e amare secondo le regole di quel mondo da favola.

programme.title: Un Casanova a Natale
programme.desc: Una podcaster aiuta un uomo a conquistare la sua cotta d'infanzia creando per lui il Natale perfetto, ma durante il percorso tra i due nasce un sentimento inatteso.

programme.title: Le vacanze di Natale
programme.desc: Una preside cerca di salvare la scuola dalla chiusura e chiede aiuto a una vecchia conoscenza diventata star di Hollywood, riscoprendo con lui sentimenti mai davvero dimenticati.

programme.title: A Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Commedia natalizia tra disavventure e seconde possibilità. A pochi giorni da Natale, Martin perde tutto e vede la sua vita andare in pezzi. Ma una serie di incontri imprevedibili e un pizzico di magia natalizia gli faranno scoprire che, proprio quando si tocca il fondo, può arrivare un nuovo inizio.

programme.title: Biglietto d'addio
programme.desc: Quando la giovane e ambiziosa studentessa di psicologia di 21 anni, Molly White, si sveglia e scopre che la sua coinquilina Emma si è tolta la vita, trova solo una nota di suicidio che descrive gli ultimi devastanti momenti della vita di Emma. Ma quando Molly inizia a vedere inquietanti visioni della morte di Emma, comincia a sospettare che ci sia molto di più nel suicidio di Emma di quanto sembri.

programme.title: Killing your Daughter
programme.desc: Quando un test del DNA aiuta Candace a connettersi con i suoi genitori biologici, si rende conto che alcune storie familiari sono meglio lasciate inespresse.

programme.title: Party from Hell
programme.desc: Denise è una madre e moglie amorevole che gestisce una startup di successo, quando assume un pianificatore di eventi professionista con una vendetta personale che capovolge il suo mondo.

programme.title: Intrecci pericolosi
programme.desc: Le gemelle Reina e Alex vedono le loro vite sconvolte dall'arrivo dell'enigmatica sorella trigemina Trinity, separata da loro alla nascita e decisa a incastrarne una per omicidio e a prendere l'identità dell'altra.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Basato sulla saga di best seller mondiali scritta dall'americana Lauren Kate, FALLEN ha per protagonista Lucinda “Luce” Price, una diciassettenne dalla forte forza di volontà che apparentemente sembra vivere una vita normale, fino a quando non viene accusata di un crimine che non ha commesso.

programme.title: Ti amo presidente
programme.desc: Due colleghi decidono di incontrarsi fuori dal prestigioso studio legale in cui lavorano. Lei, Michelle, è il supervisore di lui, l'affascinate Barack. L'incontro ha tutta l'aria di essere un primo appuntamento nonostante la reticenza di Michelle. Da quel giorno il mondo non è stato più lo stesso.

programme.title: Il segreto delle Api
programme.desc: La dottoressa Jean Markham torna nella città che aveva lasciato da adolescente per occuparsi dello studio del padre.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Layla Bennet conduce il programma mattutino Wake Up Chicago! con il suo affascinante collega Derek Dray. Non vanno sempre d'accordo e quando improvvisamente devono prendersi cura di un bambino insieme, il loro incubo peggiore diventa realtà!

programme.title: Family therapy
programme.desc: Aleksander è ossessionato dall'immagine della sua famiglia perfetta, tanto da voler partecipare a un concorso per vincere un viaggio nello spazio. L'equilibrio precario esplode quando il figlio di una precedente relazione si unisce al nucleo familiare, scoperchiando bugie e segreti taciuti.

programme.title: In fuga per la libertà
programme.desc: Una coppia lascia Budapest a causa del regime, ma è costretta ad abbandonare Suzanne, la figlia minore. Anni dopo, la ragazza si riunisce alla famiglia, ma fatica ad adattarsi negli Stati Uniti. Solo un viaggio in Ungheria le farà riscoprire il vero significato di libertà e casa.

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: Resta anche domani
programme.desc: Mia Hall (Chloë Grace Moretz) pensava che la decisione più difficile da prendere sarebbe stata scegliere tra la Juilliard o seguire un percorso diverso per stare con l'amore della sua vita, Adam. Ma un incidente d'auto cambierà tutto.

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Megan usa le settimane che precedono ogni Natale per aiutare gli altri. Chiamata a salvare la festa di Natale della sua cittadina, la ragazza si ritrova contesa tra l'uomo dei suoi sogni e il partner ideale.

programme.title: Turbolenze damore
programme.desc: Durante un volo da New York a Parigi, Antoine si ritrova seduto proprio accanto alla propria ex ragazza con la quale ha avuto una brutta rottura tre anni prima. I due rivivono così gli alti e bassi della relazione che hanno avuto.

programme.title: Lamore è complicato
programme.desc: Leah è una scrittrice che nella propria vita ha sempre cercato di evitare ogni conflitto, ma grazie a un'esperienza inaspettata riesce a trovare la propria forza interiore e a stringere nuove amicizie.

programme.title: Amore in safari
programme.desc: Una web designer statunitense eredita una riserva naturale privata in Sud Africa. Un ranger dai modi schietti la guida in un safari nella speranza che si innamori di quella terra, degli animali e di lui.

programme.title: Un matrimonio sotto lalbero
programme.desc: I genitori single Cadence e Henry non potrebbero essere meno simili, ma quando devono contribuire ai rispettivi progetti durante le festività natalizie, la chimica è innegabile. Con il Natale alle porte, riuscirà l'improbabile coppia a trovare l'amore che non sapeva di cercare?

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: I Corti di WeShort
programme.desc: The Last Architect: Nell'anno 2446, la Terra è completamente ricoperta di edifici. Nova, l'ultimo architetto, non ha più un lavoro, ma vince un concorso che le cambierà la vita. A Date with Mr Mappleton: Una cena romantica si trasforma in un incubo quando i souvenir preziosi della casa, gelosi della proprietaria, iniziano ad attaccare l'invitato. Tentatrice: Myrtille è disperatamente attratta dal cantante del cabaret. Una notte, il potere di un profumo particolare le dà la possibilità di uscire dall'ombra... 100.000 Acres of Pine: La ranger Megan Patel deve scoprire il mistero della morte del fratello. Ma seguendo le sue tracce, Megan scopre un'oscurità alla quale potrebbe non essere in grado di sfuggire. Haircut: Un'insegnante e il suo studente si trattengono in un'aula vuota. Attraverso sguardi e gesti, inizia uno strano confronto. Juliet: In un futuro non troppo lontano, la società SEED lancia con successo sul mercato Juliet, un androide da compagnia di prima generazione. La tecnologia continua così la sua avanzata e modelli sempre nuovi arrivano nei negozi ma allo stesso l'umanità ha sempre più difficoltà a trovare il proprio spazio..

programme.title: Sing Street
programme.desc: Un ragazzo cresciuto a Dublino durante gli anni '80 evade dalla sua complicata situazione familiare, formando una band per far colpo sulla ragazza che gli piace.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del vulcano
programme.desc: Per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo l'eruzione del vulcano Eyjafjallajökull è un duro colpo. Per Alain e Valerie è un disastro. Per poter arrivare nel piccolo villaggio della Grecia per il matrimonio della loro figlia, questa coppia di divorziati, che nutre un odio reciproco senza limiti, sarà costretta a intraprendere il viaggio insieme.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: Surf's Up 2 Uniti Per Vincere
programme.desc: Cody Maverick, in cerca di una nuova sfida, convince un famigerato gruppo di amanti delle onde conosciuto come gli Hang 5, ad unirsi a loro nel loro viaggio verso un misterioso luogo per fare surf, conosciuto come La Trincea, dove secondo la leggenda, troveranno le più grandi onde al mondo. Cody presto scopre che la vita che si è lasciato dietro potrebbe essere più eroica di qualsiasi cosa può offrirgli un'onda in grado di sfidare la morte.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: Quando lo stregone cattivo Gargamella insegue i piccoli puffi blu fuori dal loro villaggio, dal loro mondo magico cadono nel nostro, trovandosi nel bel mezzo di Central Park a New York. I Puffi dovranno trovare il modo di ritornare al loro villaggio prima che Gargamella li catturi.

programme.title: I Puffi 2
programme.desc: Lo stregone Gargamella crea i Monelli, delle creature furbe simili ai Puffi,per impadronirsi dell'essenza magica dei Puffi. Gargamella scopre di aver bisogno dell'aiuto di Puffetta, l'unica che sa trasformare i Monelli in Puffi. Quando Gargamella e i Monelli rapiscono Puffetta dal villaggio dei Puffi e la portano a Parigi, toccherà al Grande Puffo, Tontolone, Brontolone e Vanitoso salvare Puffetta con l'aiuto dei loro amici umani Patrick e Grace Winslow!

programme.title: I Puffi: Viaggio Nella Foresta Segreta
programme.desc: In questa nuova avventura animata dei Puffi, una mappa misteriosa conduce Puffetta e i suoi migliori amici Quattrocchi, Tontolone e Forzuto a una corsa elettrizzante nella Foresta Segreta piena di creature magiche per trovare un misterioso villaggio perduto prima che ci riesca il malvagio mago Gargamella. In una rocambolesca avventura piena d'azione e pericoli, i Puffi affrontano una missione che porterà alla scoperta di uno dei più grandi segreti nella storia dei Puffi!

programme.title: Il lumacone
programme.desc: Gianni, cuoco solo e abbandonato, realizza il sogno di un ristorante in un vagone grazie a Ginetto.

programme.title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi vedovo col complesso della buonanima
programme.desc: Il dottor Gaudenzi, giura fedeltà eterna alla moglie morta, ma è perseguitato da incidenti con le donne

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: L'invasione degli ultra sbronzi
programme.desc: In un villaggio irlandese si verificano degli strani avvenimenti: alcuni pescatori sono scomparsi nel nulla, sulle spiagge si riversano le carcasse di alcuni esemplari di balene e alcune persone muoiono in circostanze sospette.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: Quando la diciottenne Zora scopre da un'analisi del sangue di non essere imparentata con il rispettato uomo nero deceduto da tempo che aveva creduto essere suo padre, cerca il suo padre biologico nei registri di una banca del seme.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Quando Theresa porta il fidanzato Simon Green a casa per il 25° anniversario di matrimonoi dei genitori, dimentica di menzionare un piccolo dettaglio, è bianco. Deciso a rompere il fidanzamento di sua figlia, Percy Jones ci dimostra che i padri non sono sempre saggi.

programme.title: Un angelo al mio fianco
programme.desc: Amanda, giovane architetto, lavora alla ristrutturazione di una chiesa sotto la protezione invisibile del suo angelo custode, Will. Will si innamora di Amanda così i suoi superiori gli concedono una settimana da umano per conquistarla, ma nel frattempo Amanda si è invaghita di un altro ragazzo.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Shriver
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Il Figlio di Cleopatra
programme.desc: Tra congiure imperiali e battaglie spettacolari, il figlio di Cleopatra lotta per riconquistare il proprio destino e difendere l'Egitto. Diretta da Ferdinando Baldi

programme.title: I Coltelli del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un'ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: I sette gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: I dieci gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Giù le mani... carogna!
programme.desc: Il leggendario pistolero Django sta raccontando alcune delle sue più grandi avventure mentre era seduto in un saloon.

programme.title: La valle dei bruti
programme.desc: Nel 1892, dopo la morte di Phil Evarts, il suo ranch viene minacciato da allevatori avidi e ladri di bestiame. Il fratello John e la figlia Celia cercano di proteggere l'Hatchet Ranch. Will Ballard, fidato caposquadra, si batte per salvaguardare gli interessi di Celia, mentre il fidanzato di quest'ultima, Sam Danfelser, tradisce e si allea con i nemici. Con l'aiuto dello sceriffo e dei Marshals, la battaglia per il ranch raggiunge un climax drammatico.

programme.title: La morte cavalca a Rio Bravo
programme.desc: La morte cavalca a Rio Bravo - Un ex ufficiale dell'esercito uccide accidentalmente il figlio di una donna e cerca di rimediare scortando il corteo funebre attraverso il pericoloso territorio indiano.

programme.title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
programme.desc: Due uomini stanno andando a Denver City per regolare un conto personale. Uno cerca l'assassino di suo padre, l'altro un ex amico che gli ha rubato l'oro. A loro si unisce una terza persona, un misterioso pistolero.

programme.title: I due violenti
programme.desc: Uno sceriffo insegue un fuggitivo accusato di omicidio, ma scopre che è il suo vecchio amico.

programme.title: Il segno del coyote
programme.desc: Per vendicare i torti ai messicani, il figlio di un barone si finge collaboratore, ma è El Coyote.

programme.title: La notte rossa del falco
programme.desc: Un pistolero errante arriva in una città del vecchio West, dove affronta crimine e illegalità.

programme.title: I tre del Colorado
programme.desc: Per contrastare i soprusi degli inglesi, la popolazione locale cattura la figlia di un industriale.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: Il documentario racconta la straordinaria carriera della cantante inglese Amy Winehouse, fino alla sua morte.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: David Bowie ha segnato profondamente la musica rock: il documentario ci lascia un ritratto della sua carriera.

programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.desc: Un affascinante documentario sul più grande strumentista della storia del rock, Jimi Hendrix, morto nel 1970.

programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia di John Denver, dagli esordi nel folk fino ai successi degli anni 70.

programme.desc: Non solo country. Il documentario racconta la maestria di Cash e la sua capacità di spaziare tra i generi.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.desc: Il documentario racconta la storia di Tom Petty, leader dei Tom Petty and the Heartbreaks, fino alla morte.

programme.desc: David Bowie ha segnato profondamente la musica rock: il documentario ci lascia un ritratto della sua carriera.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.
